coverage_gaps: Citation-graph and DOI metadata routes are unavailable, limiting systematic forward- and backward-citation expansion beyond links exposed by PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov.
Non-US regulator databases are unavailable, so regulatory conclusions are limited to FDA actions.
Additional subject indexes such as Embase are unavailable, which may reduce recall for conference abstracts and non-MEDLINE journals.
Preprint routes are unavailable, limiting explicit assessment of unpublished or unreviewed analyses through the cutoff.
exclusion_criteria: Studies limited to non-rheumatoid-arthritis indications unless they directly informed an included FDA action or clarify a labeled tofacitinib safety risk.
Preclinical, mechanistic, pharmacokinetic, or efficacy-only reports without a decision-relevant safety outcome.
Case reports or uncontrolled anecdotes that cannot qualify a comparative risk estimate, except when explicitly cited in an FDA safety action.
Duplicate bibliographic records after identifier-based canonicalization, while preserving their separate query-hit occurrences.
Commentary, news, or narrative opinion lacking new data and lacking authoritative correction, retraction, registry, or regulatory status information.
Reports concerning another Janus kinase inhibitor without separately extractable tofacitinib evidence or direct relevance to an FDA class action affecting tofacitinib.
inclusion_criteria: Records available on or before 2024-12-31, with online-first, issue, registry-update, and regulatory effective dates recorded separately.
The pivotal postauthorization tofacitinib safety study, its ClinicalTrials.gov record, primary publication, linked secondary analyses, and FDA actions informed by its interim or final findings.
Adult rheumatoid arthritis evidence evaluating marketed tofacitinib doses and reporting cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, or mortality outcomes.
Comparative evidence using tumor necrosis factor inhibitors or another clinically interpretable rheumatoid arthritis comparator.
Observational studies, systematic reviews, and meta-analyses that directly corroborate, qualify, or conflict with the pivotal study's decision-relevant safety findings.
Corrections, errata, retractions, expressions of concern, registry amendments, and regulatory label revisions linked by title, identifier, DOI, or explicit citation.
Each canonical record must retain every query-to-record occurrence and all available identifiers used to connect registry, publication, and regulatory sources.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal postauthorization study and validate its names and identifiers.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "A3921133"[All Fields]) AND tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]

queries.purpose: Recover the canonical registry record, study design, outcome definitions, sponsor identifiers, results, and linked publications.
Recover FDA materials explicitly tied to the pivotal safety trial.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib OR Xeljanz "ORAL Surveillance" OR NCT02092467

queries.purpose: Retrieve broad peer-reviewed safety evidence across all decision-relevant outcomes.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690,550"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[MeSH Terms] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignancy[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembolism[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find related registered rheumatoid arthritis safety studies and identifier links that may qualify the anchor study.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch] "Rheumatoid Arthritis" AND AREA[InterventionSearch] tofacitinib AND (safety OR cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Map the FDA safety-action timeline and locate effective labels and communications.
queries.query: site:fda.gov (tofacitinib OR Xeljanz OR Xeljanz XR) (safety communication OR boxed warning OR label OR prescribing information) (cardiovascular OR cancer OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR blood clots OR death)

queries.purpose: Confirm the primary publication, registry identifier, comparison groups, noninferiority analysis, and primary cardiovascular and malignancy findings.
queries.query: ("Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields])

queries.purpose: Confirm thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and mortality findings in primary or prespecified secondary reports.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembolism[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Cross-check posted results, serious adverse events, outcome definitions, enrollment, doses, and publication links against the primary report.
queries.query: NCT02092467 AND (Results OR Adverse Events OR Outcome Measures OR Publications)

queries.purpose: Confirm FDA actions prompted by interim and final trial findings, including dates, affected products, risks, and prescribing restrictions.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib (2019 OR 2021) (pulmonary embolism OR thrombosis OR heart-related events OR cancer OR blood clots OR death OR boxed warning)

queries.purpose: Retrieve external observational evidence that may corroborate, qualify, or conflict with ORAL Surveillance.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignancy[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find subgroup and risk-stratification analyses explaining heterogeneity by age, smoking, baseline risk, and dose.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (subgroup[Title/Abstract] OR age[Title/Abstract] OR smoking[Title/Abstract] OR "cardiovascular risk"[Title/Abstract] OR dose[Title/Abstract] OR biomarker[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Seek null, negative, or conflicting comparative evidence and test the robustness of the safety interpretation.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("TNF inhibitor"[Title/Abstract] OR TNFi[Title/Abstract]) AND (null[Title/Abstract] OR comparable[Title/Abstract] OR conflicting[Title/Abstract] OR inconsistent[Title/Abstract] OR "no increased risk"[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type])

queries.purpose: Identify corrections, errata, retractions, or expressions of concern affecting the pivotal publication or related reports.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR Published Erratum[Publication Type] OR correction[Title] OR erratum[Title] OR retraction[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title]))

queries.purpose: Capture registry amendments and status changes through the temporal cutoff while distinguishing study updates from publication dates.
queries.query: NCT02092467 | Study Record and History of Changes | Last Update Posted on or before 2024-12-31

queries.purpose: Check for FDA label revisions, safety updates, or corrected communications through 2024-12-31.
queries.query: site:fda.gov (tofacitinib OR Xeljanz OR Xeljanz XR) (safety OR label OR boxed warning OR Drug Safety Communication) before:2025-01-01

question_frame: Safety PECO: among adults with marketed tofacitinib-treated rheumatoid arthritis, especially patients aged 50 years or older with at least one cardiovascular risk factor, compare tofacitinib doses with tumor necrosis factor inhibitors and characterize major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy, venous and arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and all-cause or cardiovascular mortality through 2024-12-31; link the pivotal postauthorization study across registry, primary publication, and FDA actions, then identify qualifying or conflicting evidence and evidence-integrity notices.
stop_rules: Complete all planned sentinel, discovery, confirmation, expansion, challenge, and update events across every route in source_map.

Recover NCT02092467, its primary peer-reviewed publication, and the FDA actions tied to interim and final ORAL Surveillance findings; escalate terminology and identifier searches if any anchor is missing.
Establish identifier-level links among the registry record, primary publication, secondary analyses, and FDA materials before synthesis.
Retrieve direct evidence for cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis or pulmonary embolism, and mortality, or explicitly record an outcome-specific evidence gap.
Complete dedicated searches for qualifying or conflicting evidence and for correction, erratum, retraction, and expression-of-concern status.
Stop expansion after two consecutive identifier, linked-publication, or author-based passes add no decision-relevant evidence through the cutoff.
Stop when all included claims can be traced to a primary study, registry result, or dated FDA source and further retrieval cannot change the safety conclusion.
Stop at 16 query events; if an anchor or required outcome remains unresolved at budget exhaustion, report it as an unresolved coverage gap rather than inferring a result.
